resources.string: A soldier follows the stars home through an unknown landscape. A difficult choice awaits at the end of the journey.
A lighthouse keeper returns to the coast. A letter from the past changes everything he thought he knew about his family.
Unexpected snowfall brings old friends together in a cabin. Quiet evenings and Christmas preparations give them a fresh start.
An inherited diary leads two siblings back to an abandoned house. Each night, another window lights up.
A small restaurant gets one last chance when an unexpected guest orders dinner for the whole village.
The last bus passes the same house three times. One passenger decides to get off.
A photographer searches for the perfect light along the coast and discovers a community he did not know he missed.
A father and daughter set out on a winter journey. A closed mountain pass sends them on an unexpected detour.
A research team discovers a signal beneath the sand on a distant planet. The answer comes from their own future.
Three generations meet for Sunday dinner. The recipes are familiar, but none of them returns home quite the same.
Employees have separated their memories of work from life outside. Then the two worlds begin to overlap.
A small investigation team follows the trail of a missing ship. Everyone along the coast knows each other, but nobody knows everything.
A family takes over a mountain lodge just before Christmas. Every guest brings a story they did not expect.
A new employee finds a door missing from the floor plan. Her colleagues insist that the floor does not exist.
A chef takes over the family restaurant. The chaos in the kitchen is easier to manage than the people around him.
An old disappearance resurfaces in the archives. The investigator finds a pattern stretching across generations.
A journey along the coast, from busy harbours to small communities where the sea still sets the rhythm of daily life.
When the dark season comes, a small hotel opens its doors to travellers and neighbours who need a place to stay.
A crew follows a signal to the edge of known space.
